style: Use case: stylized-concept. One finished landscape 3:2 illustration for an OMNIPATH collectible Card. Restrained premium folklore trading-card oil painting, tactile painterly detail and realistic materials, ancient global mythic world, cinematic natural light, deep rich shadows with a clearly readable illuminated subject. Clear single focal action, close composition readable at thumbnail size. Center subject in horizontal middle for wide card-art crop. Art only, no frame, no words, no numbers, no lettering, no graphic icons, no logos, no watermark. Scene:

cards.scene: A massive stone-headed war hammer shatters basalt in a decisive downward blow.
Living roots weave into a dense curved shield before an incoming spear, protection forming in a rain-dark forest.
A warrior's forearm becomes layered bark armor; an attacking blade hits it and sharp splinters spring back toward the attacker.
An immense ancient serpentine dragon unleashes a focused fiery blast across a mountain ravine, overwhelming finishing force, no gore.
Warm healing light rises from deep tree roots into a wounded traveler's cupped hands at the base of an old tree, restoration.
An amber-lit living oak heart within a bark chestplate, protective roots coiling around it and a gathered pulse of strength.
A thorny living shield catches a sword blow and lashes sharp brambles back toward the attack, one clear close-up defensive counter.
A warrior sheltered behind a translucent protective barrier brings down a heavy iron axe, controlled follow-through and bright sparks.
A traveler sheltered within a luminous ring of ancient standing stones, dark curse-like smoke dissolving outward, profound protection and cleansing.
A taut strand of silver silk slices cleanly through a reed stalk, a gloved hand drawing the thread, tiny precise physical attack.
A watchful hand follows glowing threads that trace the path of an approaching blade, seeing the attack before it arrives.
A web of luminous silk bends an incoming bronze spear in a sweeping arc back toward the distant figure who threw it, redirection.
A beautiful hollow golden mask cracks against a protective barrier, revealing a hidden jagged dagger aimed through the fractured Ward.
Careful fingers pull one golden thread from a tightly woven magical attack, causing the whole incoming spell to unravel into harmless loose strands.
A cracked ancient hourglass suspended inside a thin protective shell, a few golden grains gathering into a future burst of strength.
A small patient spider repairing dew-covered silk above a traveler's healing hands, calm restorative stillness, no threatening bite.
A weathered storyteller's scroll curls into a powerful shadow serpent delivering a final strike, closing a known tale, no readable writing.
A small woven protective charm reveals a concealed thorn as an incoming blade touches it, modest defense with a hidden returning sting.
A sharp crescent of wind from a sword sweeps through windblown leaves on a mountain path, clean decisive cut.
Two sword blades meet in a precise close-up parry, defender's blade gliding along the attack toward an immediate answering strike.
An immense narrow sword arc parts storm clouds above jagged mountains, a forceful sky-cleaving finishing attack.
A young traveler's short blade cuts through a small fresh gust of leaves, quick simple opening strike at dawn.
A seated traveler beside a still mountain pool, dark mist lifting from their shoulders as a soft restorative glow reflects on water.
A broad dark raven wing sweeps between a traveler and an incoming blade, feathers catching the impact and deflecting it.
A spear point descends from a high rocky ledge toward a shattered stone target, concentrated mountain-top precision and force.
A light-footed fighter takes a swift step wrapped in a small protective swirl of wind, strength gathering around their next poised strike.
A disciplined swordsman waits motionless with blade angled toward an approaching shadow, sudden bright answering cut before the attack lands.
A traveler stands protected within a dense stone-like translucent barrier while a mountain storm breaks harmlessly around it.
A single copper autumn leaf rides the edge of a quick low sword cut, delicate economical strike in a forest clearing.
A long living branch whips sharply across a forest path, bark and leaves trailing along a powerful focused lash.
A mantle of lush moss wraps a traveler's shoulders into soft protective layers while small warm lights mend a scraped arm.
A battered forest wanderer transforms into a fierce wolf mid-leap, recovering strength for a desperate counteroffensive, no gore.
An incoming strike loses its way among twisting forest paths and misleading shadows, a protected traveler slipping safely aside.
Old cracked bark peels away from a forest spirit to reveal fresh healthy wood beneath, dark blight crumbling off in renewal.
A defender braces behind a quickly raised bramble shield; an enemy blade makes contact and a thorny vine lashes back. Show an immediate defensive counter, not a planted trap or creature summon.
Luminous wildflowers bloom across protective vines around a wounded traveler, healing light and a living shield together.
A twisted gnarled bough snaps forward in an unexpected crooked angle, striking a wooden practice target, unruly forest force.
Soft violet poisonous spores drift from nocturnal mushrooms toward a distant silhouette, with a small sheltering fungal cap in foreground.
A brilliant lance of warm sunlight pierces through dark clouds toward a cracked stone target, focused solar attack.
First dawn light touches a traveler's bruised hand and gathers into a small golden spark above their poised weapon, healing and preparation.
A traveler offers a small red life-like ember from their palm into an ancient stone bowl, their weapon answering with restrained powerful light; sacrifice without gore.
A round shield of sunrise light catches an incoming arrow and throws a narrow ray back along its path, warm defensive counter.
Clouds open into a clear blue vault that disperses an incoming dark bolt above a traveler, a thin luminous shield remains.
A crown of living solar fire burns above a warrior's bowed head, a red ember drawn from their chest into an immense outward blast; costly power without gore.
Three successive arcs of a practiced weapon stroke meet along a glowing horizon, a rising final attack after earlier movements.
A fighter makes a misleading shallow blade thrust while keeping a second small weapon visibly unused in the other hand, cunning reserve and opportunity.
A battered defender catches a blow on a cracked shield while pivoting into a returning strike, a reversal from a losing position.
Gentle turquoise tide rises around an exhausted island traveler, luminous water mending their wounds and lifting their stance.
A colossal ancient carved fishhook hauls a heavy stone island upward through the sea, explosive physical force and crashing spray.
A daring hand lays a single red life ember beside weathered carved bones, golden power gathering around a waiting fist, risk traded for future strength.
A protective wall of turquoise water shatters forward into a spear-like surge, the shield itself becoming the attack.
A determined spear thrust drives upstream through a rushing protective water barrier, an opportunistic attack that grows stronger against defense.
A plain short bronze blade flashes in one fast economical strike against a hanging rope, simple universally useful technique.
Silken strands catch an incoming luminous attack and guide it around in a tight return loop toward its caster, clear magical redirection.
An expertly placed thin blade slips through a tiny seam in a heavy shield, exact controlled cut that bypasses protection.
A fighter recoils from a glancing blow then immediately answers with a compact strong punch, resilience and post-impact retaliation, no gore.
Two smooth Omen stones sit within an ancient ritual circle around a traveler; healing light rises and a strong protective veil forms, no writing or interface symbols.
Calm hands hold two plain faceted Omen stones above still water, attention gathering as small neutral light points, deliberate focus.
A dark empty faceted Omen turns in a traveler's hand while another carved Omen rotates to its opposite side, void-inspired manipulation, no UI or floating icons.
A fine luminous thread tugs one physical Omen within an incoming spell down by a small precise turn, causing the structured spell to falter.

edits.instruction: Replace central idol with a physical octahedral d8 with engraved 5 and 4. Preserve hand, thread, interrupted spell, composition and lighting. No UI overlays.
